# Arena result-tree contamination record — 2026-10-04

## Event

During the 2026-10-04 E2E audit, one full test-suite run
(`PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest tests/ -q`, 12:55 UTC) rewrote
`episodes.jsonl` in 14 historical result directories under
`arena/results/raw/`. Mechanism: deterministic run-ID collision + `"w"`-mode
write (`src/arena/episode.py`, `src/arena/ablation_runner.py`); see
`RAPHAEL_E2E_AUDIT_20261004.md` §4 (TI-1). `.gitignore` has carried the comment
"regenerated by every test run" for `arena/results/raw/*/episodes.jsonl`,
treating the symptom by ignoring the files.

## Pre-M0 protected baseline

`PRE_M0_SHA256SUMS.txt` — SHA-256 of every file under `arena/results/raw/`
(52,022 files) taken 2026-10-04 BEFORE any M0 change. **This is the baseline
the M0 acceptance compares against**: after the isolation fix, a further suite
run must leave the tree byte-identical to this baseline. Note the baseline
itself is the POST-contamination state for the 14 dirs below (original
contents were already overwritten on Oct 4 and are not recoverable from this
tree — the files are git-ignored, so git history holds no copy either).

6 un-suffixed `_dev` dirs with mtime 2026-09-03 (pre-clone) were NOT mutated:
`abl_{FULL_RAPHAEL,NO_HYPOTHESIS,NO_LLM,NO_PLANNER,NO_WORLD_MODEL,SCRIPTED_BASELINE}_known-observable_s0042_dev`.
The 428 hash-suffixed run dirs were not mutated.

## Recovery decision (TI-2, recorded separately per M0-B)

The frozen `evaluations/campaign/rbs_v4_holdout.jsonl` (1,200 rows, SHA-256
`2bf614f8eafa0253…` per README/manifest) is absent from the working tree and
was never committed (`git log --all` on the path is empty). Decision for M0:
**unverifiable-in-repo** — no regeneration or fabrication attempted. Recovery
from origin/backup remains possible and is recommended; until then the
reproducibility manifest must not be cited as validated. History rewrite is
out of scope without operator authorization.
